parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm with narrow QRS, right axis deviation (negative QRS in I, positive in II, III and aVF), a dominant tall R in V1 with T-wave inversion in V1–V2, and persistent S waves in V5–V6, which fits right ventricular hypertrophy with strain. There is no RBBB, no AV block, and no significant ST elevation.
